remaining_test_target: application library with cfg(test), same features and dependencies as the completed main harness graph
reserve_basis: Full production application library and all test dependency units already compiled; remaining root library test code generation/linking uses the ordinary heavy-build reservation rather than the initial cold graph reservation of32GiB. No output relocation or cache deletion.

product_scope.basis: Normal product build uses the ordinary heavy-build reservation. Test-only taproot estimated-probe-fixtures and transport test-identity features can create different normal-build dependency units, so the remaining product is not assumed to be a link-only operation.
